snapshot.codeHealth10Less: Code health is 10 less three capped deductions (size over 500 lines, deepest nesting and average nesting over the language's thresholds), never below 1; a component's is the line-weighted mean of its files'. The hotspot score is log2(commits + 1) × lines, scaled so the hottest file in the snapshot reads 100.
snapshot.codeHealthFromFunctions: Code health is 10 less three deductions, never below 1: complex code (a point per doubling of the lines in functions over cognitive complexity 15), coupling (a point and a half per doubling of imports past 10) and size (a point per doubling of code lines past 150); languages no pack parses are read by their indentation. A component's is its files' weighted by code lines. The hotspot score is log2(commits + 1) × lines, scaled so the hottest file in the snapshot reads 100.
